chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: The finale, newspaper write-ups and Transatlantic Rhythm in London
summary: He introduces the creators in the finale and was written up in every city; in 1936 he went to London for the short-lived Transatlantic Rhythm.

take a show to England with Lou Holtz, Luther Velez, Buck and Bubbles, Ruth Etting to do the show called "Transatlantic Rhythm" at the West Side Theater, called the Adelphia Theater in London. The show was really expensive, they packed the house but they couldn't pay off the showgirls, you see. So that's why the show didn't last but only four weeks. That's when we got the information to come back to America because Nazarro had a picture for us. And I'm fixin' on going to Australia. I just missed the boat to go to Australia where I was going to go. Instead of coming back to America I was going to go to Australia.
